link_profile.description: Preset ceilings only. LAN retains 500000000 ns grant lease and 250000000 ns input age. Internet uses unverified starting ceilings of 3000000000 ns and 750000000 ns. Clients request their own lease from measured round trip.

max_grant_lease_ns.description: Overrides the preset; whole milliseconds. Unverified absolute bound: 10 s. A longer granted lease increases the worst-case unattended-stop delay after the operator link dies.

max_jog_input_age_ns.description: Overrides the preset. Unverified absolute bound: 2 s. A longer age permits a stale velocity command to continue longer, bounded by its original expiry and the existing jog expiry ramp.
